items.source: Note that @NestedTestConfiguration does not apply to this annotation: @SpringExtensionConfig will always be detected within a @Nested test class hierarchy, effectively disregarding any @NestedTestConfiguration(OVERRIDE) declarations.
items.translation: 注意，@NestedTestConfiguration不适用于此注解：@SpringExtensionConfig 将始终在 @Nested 测试类层次结构中被检测到，从而实际上忽略任何 @NestedTestConfiguration(OVERRIDE) 声明。

items.source: This annotation is only applicable to @Nested test class hierarchies and should be applied to the top-level enclosing class of a @Nested test class hierarchy. Consequently, there is no need to declare this annotation on a test class that does not contain @Nested test classes.
items.translation: 此注解仅适用于包含 `@Nested` 测试类层次结构的顶层包装类，因此无需在不包含 `@Nested` 测试类的测试类上声明此注解。

items.source: By default, the SpringExtension uses a test-method scoped ExtensionContext. Thus, there is no need to declare this annotation attribute with a value of false.
items.translation: 默认情况下，`SpringExtension` 使用测试方法作用域的 `ExtensionContext`。因此，无需声明此注解属性并设置值为 `false`。

items.source: Specify whether the SpringExtension should use a test-class scoped ExtensionContext within @Nested test class hierarchies.
items.translation: 指定 `SpringExtension` 是否应在 `@Nested` 测试类层次结构中使用测试类范围的ExtensionContext。
